headword: {海面上昇|かいめんじょうしょう}
reading: かいめんじょうしょう

definitions.explanation: The increase in the level of the world's oceans, primarily caused by thermal expansion of seawater and melting of glaciers and ice sheets due to global warming.

examples.japanese: {海面上昇|かいめんじょうしょう}が{進|すす}んでいる。
{海面上昇|かいめんじょうしょう}により{島|しま}が{沈|しず}む{危険|きけん}がある。
examples.english: There is a danger that islands will sink due to sea level rise.

examples.japanese: {地球温暖化|ちきゅうおんだんか}による{海面上昇|かいめんじょうしょう}は{沿岸部|えんがんぶ}の{住民|じゅうみん}に{大|おお}きな{影響|えいきょう}を{与|あた}える。
examples.english: Sea level rise caused by global warming has a major impact on residents of coastal areas.

notes:
A compound of {海面|かいめん} (sea surface/sea level) + {上昇|じょうしょう} (rise, increase). A key term in discussions about climate change and environmental policy. Japan, as an island nation with extensive coastlines, is particularly concerned about this phenomenon.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {海面上昇|かいめんじょうしょう}の{影響|えいきょう}: impact of sea level rise
- {海面上昇|かいめんじょうしょう}の{予測|よそく}: prediction of sea level rise
- {海面上昇|かいめんじょうしょう}への{対策|たいさく}: countermeasures against sea level rise

RELATED WORDS:
- {地球温暖化|ちきゅうおんだんか}: global warming — the primary cause of sea level rise
- {気候変動|きこうへんどう}: climate change — the broader phenomenon
- {氷河|ひょうが}: glacier — melting glaciers contribute to sea level rise
